title: skill-descriptor
description: What a skill is, read from its directory: identity, content digest, the optional fields of the Agent Skills standard and where the skill came from. Produced by `aicore.content.skill.describe_skill`; values come from the SKILL.md frontmatter and the `upstream.json` next to it and are never rewritten, an absent value is null, an empty list or an empty map.

id.description: Identity of the skill: `<bucket>/<name>` in the skiller library, `<module>/<name>` elsewhere.

digest.description: Tagged SHA-256 of the skill content: the `content_sha256` algorithm of the skill registry (all files except upstream.json, localized SKILL.*.md, .claude-plugin, evals and bytecode caches).

license.description: Frontmatter `license`; otherwise the `license` of upstream.json; otherwise null.

compatibility.description: Frontmatter `compatibility`: free text on environment requirements, 1-500 characters by the standard (the length is checked by the producer). Never executed.

allowed_tools.description: Frontmatter `allowed-tools` as a list. Pre-approval of tools in Claude Code only; not a requirement and not a security boundary.

adapters.description: Frontmatter `adapters`: the agents the skill is written for.

requires.description: Frontmatter `requires`: skills this skill depends on.

metadata.description: Frontmatter `metadata`: the free-form map of the standard, string keys to string values (an open object, the keys are the author's).

origin.description: Where `skiller describe` found the skill: the library, a machine custom directory or the project's `.swissknifeman/skills`; absent when the descriptor comes from `describe_skill` alone.

provenance.description: Origin of the skill: `{"source": "local"}` when it has no upstream.json, otherwise the recorded upstream data.

source.description: `local` for a skill kept in this repository, else the upstream source such as `github`.

strategy.description: How upstream changes are followed, as recorded by upstream.json.

files.description: Upstream files the skill was fetched from.

audit.description: Result of the last upstream audit.

file.description: One upstream file and its fetch record, as recorded; a reference-only record has an empty path and sha256.

path.description: Path inside the skill directory; empty for a reference-only record.

url.description: Where the file was fetched from, or the reference.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the fetched file, hex; empty for a reference-only record.

fetched_at.description: Date or time of the fetch as recorded.

at.description: Date or time of the audit as recorded.

upstream_sha.description: Upstream commit the audit looked at.
